theme.rationale: E-commerce and consumer service apps perform best with light themes to maximize product visibility, trust, and legibility. An energetic, high-contrast light theme fits the Shopee-style dynamic vibe.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers to feel bold, punchy, and app-like.

body.usage: Clean, geometric sans for dense mobile UIs. Excellent legibility at small text sizes.

anti_patterns_enforced: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

primary.description: High-energy Electric Orange. Drives action and creates the 'Shopee-style' urgency.

background.description: Warm tinted grey for main app background, pure white for content cards to create elevation.

neutral.description: Warm-tinted blacks and greys. Never use pure #000000 for text.

mobile_app_view.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile views, featuring 4-5 core tabs (Home, Shop, Bookings, Account) with active state highlighting (Orange).
mobile_app_view.header: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a 1px border-b border-black/5. CRITICAL: Do not use fully transparent headers.
mobile_app_view.spacing: Dense but readable. Use p-4 to p-6 for containers. Avoid excessive whitespace that reduces product density on mobile screens.

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (dark or pure white), dense grid layout for metrics. Cardless or 1px subtle borders (border-neutral-200), NO soft drop shadows.
admin_dashboard.density: Tight gap-4 grids. Maximum data visibility.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Sharp inner contrast, active scale-down animation (active:scale-95).
components.cards: Soft Neumorphic touch for the consumer app: pure white background, subtle shadow-sm, rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl. For admin: square or rounded-md with 1px solid border.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Filled style (bg-neutral-100) instead of outlined on mobile to reduce visual noise. Highlight border-primary on focus.
components.badges: Flash sale or discount badges must be bold and pill-shaped, overlapping product images at the top-left.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on the bottom nav and top sticky header. MUST include a 1px delicate inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.bento_grids: Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) for homepage dynamic banners (e.g., 'Spin & Win' taking a large span, 'Sell Phone' taking a tall span).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary orange gradient banners to break the 'flat digital' feel.

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion slide-up and fade-in for route changes to mimic native app navigation.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for product grids and repair model selections.
motion.interactions: Micro-bouncing on icon taps, smooth expand/collapse for accordion elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the primary orange meets 3:1 minimum contrast. Use text-neutral-900 instead of white if the orange tint gets too light.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all clickable elements in the consumer mobile UI.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='bottom-nav-home').

shop_accessories.description: Colorful flatlay with phone and accessories

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for all iconography. Keep stroke width consistent at 2px. Use filled variants only for active bottom nav states.

instructions_to_main_agent: This project uses .js/.jsx files (not .tsx). Ensure all React components and imports are formulated using JavaScript syntax.

Build the homepage entirely dynamically. Create a JSON configuration or map array that defines sections (banner, repair_service, flash_sale, etc.) and render them recursively to simulate an admin-controlled layout.

Implement a Mobile-First layout. Confine the main consumer app view to a max-w-md or max-w-lg container centered on desktop, mimicking a phone screen, or build a fully responsive UI that feels like an app on mobile (with bottom nav) and scales intelligently.
For the Admin Panel, create a separate route/layout (/admin) that uses the full width of the screen, with a sidebar and dense data tables.
Use Framer Motion for the multi-step repair booking flow and the 'Sell Phone' condition questionnaire.

Implement Shadcn/UI (in .jsx) for modals, drawers (crucial for mobile bottom sheets), dropdowns, and form elements. Customize the border-radii to be more rounded (e.g., radius 1rem) for the consumer app.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a 'data-testid' attribute for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Be distinctive.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate. Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container text by default.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing for marketing/consumer sections, and tight bento grids for admin layouts.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements for robust testing.
